method: Read index, config and safetensors JSON headers only; no tensor payload or whole-weight hash.
limitations: Serialized tensor bytes include associated quantization scales, zero points and expert-local metadata; they are not model parameter counts.
The denominator includes all checkpoint tensors, including nonlanguage tensors and draft tensors when present; runtime language-only paths may not load these.
Draft expert namespaces mtp.* and GLM layer47 (beyond num_hidden_layers47) are separated from native primary expert blocks.
GPT fused expert tensors are apportioned equally along the validated expert dimension; serialization does not establish runtime slicing support.
These are static byte accounting estimates. Runtime repacking, shared scales, allocator reservations, shared experts, KV cache and workspace require direct resident-memory measurement.
No expert is deleted and no memory or accuracy benefit is measured by this inventory.
